newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 24.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* Excessive speculation on the local stock market is not good for investors, said Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Wednesday night.
* In the U.S. the Dow Jones industrial average fell 21 points to 6,812.72.
* Malaysian blue-chip stocks slid 10.90 lower to 1,109.60 in thin trading, on lingering concerns over the effects of oversupply in the property market, analysts said.
* "I don't think Mahathir's speech (on share speculation) last night will have too much of an impact today," said Ooi Soon Beng, head of research at Inter-Pacific Securities.

* "It's hard to say exactly what the extent of the impact of of Bank Negara's move (to curb property financing) is going to be on share prices from now. Most analysts agree there will be some impact, but no one's really sure how great it's going to be," said an institutional dealer at a local brokerage house.
* Analysts and dealers said Thursday was likely to be a listless trading day, with share prices drifting sideways.
